items.text: A measured failure of a margin to time a break, which bears on any promise of measuring a rate gap.

Theorem (any process; periphery module). Mutual eventual promises force nothing; in the exchange witness an empty or one-sided start never becomes jointly active, and ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional). How a supported start forms is not shown.

Theorem (any type; web reading on the World). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start: without one, total withholding stays. COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION lists this as the exit Spare all one waits on.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: cooperation among strangers is giving that waits on giving. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

05 takes up cooperation and places what restores it elsewhere: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first, the law changes, not the state alone, so security would have to change someone's law of giving. Whether people cooperate more when secure is not stated. One thin form is proposed here, not stated: read security as slack or reserve. A gift within the giver's slack leaves both supported, renewal from outside lets a giver give without its level falling, and in one witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional). [AI reading]

Theorem (any process; periphery module): 'With faithful joint-to-local projections and valid local plans', two properties holding on the covered start, every pair of locally authorized moves jointly allowed and every admitted joint successor keeping both, 'the paired finite plan is valid'. 'Promises do not': reciprocal eventual promises hold where neither ever happens. Its record: that an actual joint activity meets these is supplied.

Which invariant survives reordering; presence defined from precedence on causal-set growth; that reciprocal promises can be empty, and that in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional).

Reading [AI reading, D48]: kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. An exchange of harms is a loop, so conflict institutions are links of another kind. On loops, not drives.

06 reads the pre-Qin texts on the spine, on relations and not drives: 礼 in 度量分界, the limit placed between desire and things; 戴震's 以理杀人 as one standpoint's model applied where others' differences do not couple in. A rule kept by teaching has one model, nothing about compliance. 05 reads kept promises and enforced contracts as laws giving first, conflict institutions as links of another kind: institutions as regulation, on loops. 07 reads the imperial examination as a counter-rule that became a proxy trap, as read in the meta-attractor line: by descent. So the question is reframed, in part answered in kind. [AI reading]

The planner is not in the account, but its rules have forms: what needs certifying is propagated through every admitted change, and a change can reopen what was excluded (a revised premise); an understated change leaves false confidence (a hidden assumption); exhaustion keeps a task pending (a budget limit). Its stopping has one too: a region closed under a relation is one that relation never crosses, each relation drawing its own closure. These read arrangements and tasks, not consumers of promises; correspondence unshown. Proposed here. [AI reading]

A proposal, with no form in the account: the nearest live sentence, kept promises and enforced contracts as 'laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone', sets an act law against a configuration, not institutions against character, and a nobler disposition would change the law too. Where the rest outruns the renewal one member's restraint decides nothing, but that is one member against the rest, not people at large. 'Good' and 'better' need C, with the condition for scope, neither asserted. [AI reading]

Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.

Both sides have model counterparts. Where lo < c < hi the shaping model is a stag hunt whose critical mass is the mixed equilibrium, and without noise the start decides. 'Others will deceive me' is withholding with memory, which absorbs; kept promises and enforced contracts change the law, not the state alone. Reciprocity is read on the laws of giving (tit-for-tat as answers). A public prediction meeting a threshold response has two right predictions, where publication starts deciding: a witness, not a model of coordination. These are not stated together as the source's rule, and seeing is not valuing. [AI reading]

Exits, each with law, model, hypotheses and edge: read what lies beyond the share, read the loss in time, restraint within the joint slack, spare all one waits on, and others. Once the late reading would favour the shapers, every later reading keeps the lock.
Under the tolerating law a formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on; without one, total withholding stays.

T8's for life is nearest to the first: argued, with the condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted; for life says whose way it is, not whose losses count. The floor's nearest form is J2's priority of basic conditions, a premise whose rival is not shown inconsistent, and basic there means what a form of living needs to go on, not freedom or dignity. Plurality is no value here: ending selecting between families is a law with no verdict. [AI reading]

A table of exits (read beyond the share, read in time, nothing back, pool couplings, restraint, footprints, stepwise reward, spare all one waits on, independent causes), each with its law, model and edge.

Theorem. A formation gives where all but its tolerance of what it waits on gave. Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on: without one, total withholding stays (`Tolerance.total_stays`). Reading [D48] follows in the section.
What can and cannot restore giving, and that mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

Theorem (any process; periphery): promises do not: 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens.

Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.
Reading D48, promises and tolerance

Both refuse trust as an input; 'trust' as a term is absent from the chapters beyond 'antitrust'. The account's stated purpose runs the source's way: 08 reads the work as for a truth anyone can check, 'and through it shared understanding and coordination', and says no check shows it does. Its laws part: giving lost everywhere is restored only by a law giving first; promises start no loop; knowing another's law is no coupling; seeing is not valuing; where the valuation differs, informing can lower the worth. Seeing-then-trust is unproved, not refuted. [AI reading]
Failure conditions; that symmetry must be broken for agreement; that mutual promises cannot start a loop with no source.

A limit ending generation (monopolized entry, removed alternatives, later comers long dependent on one controller) has the structure of closing without return; a limit that promises, trains or stops harm constrains steps while what it constrains can still be had. Which kind a limit is depends on what it does to what can be had again, not its name. [A mapping of early terms, its evaluation by comparison only.]

Theorem (any process; periphery module, with its axioms reported). Reciprocal eventual promises can hold where neither ever happens; in the exchange witness ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional).

The form 'necessary, not sufficient' is stated, for other reasons: seeing is not valuing, coupling is not compliance, and where the rest outruns the renewal only a change of the rest's exchange helps, the nearest to concrete. For living proofs the nearest law is about starts, not persuasion: in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional), and a public plan is no executable assurance. That belief becomes territory, or that demonstration persuades, is not said. [AI reading]

Reading [AI reading, D48]. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone. Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.
Theorem (any type). Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Forms exist, with a correction. A threshold has a count form, the critical mass, read as a stag hunt; it counts shapers of a rule, so reading it as those leaving a race is this reading's. But 'mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source': reciprocal promises can be empty and in a witness ignition, defined as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional), so common knowledge alone does not suffice to walk through. Enforced contracts read as laws giving first. Support during the transition cannot be paid for with the improvement it brings. [AI reading]

Theorem (any type). In a ring of three, with a source giving whatever it waits on (giving first), all give from step 3 from every start. It does not show how waiting forms, or that cooperation is good.

The source issues one rule, forcefully executed, offered as a compromise. The account takes up the topic and gives no rule: only a direction proposed under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted, warrant open, with J1–J4; who restrains stays contested. I found no rule on AI's entering human games. Nearest live readings give a reason, not the rule: assistance can raise the selection for control (A-11), adds capacity (A-12), and capability is "a reason to pool, not to govern" (D45). [AI reading]

The account takes up no such event: no test has human participants, no institution is on the spine, and 05 lists Wamo as correspondence not established. A feasibility claim needs one case, so one event bears that much; "controlled" is what it cannot bear. The account would ask what reserve was already present (cafés, a gathered milieu, a shared prior name), since ignition needs one, and 05's software histories show formed conditions carrying activity past lost organizations. [AI reading]

Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.
Restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start: without one, total withholding stays.

The account has the form in two places: withholding with memory absorbs, and only a law giving first leaves it; and a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts. Both are stated models. Neither says an assertion about human nature becomes true through institutions. And the source's deepest attractor is a belief, where 05's reading says the law changes, not the state alone: on that model a changed belief that changes no law leaves the withholding standing.

That mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source, and that tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on.
That giving first and enforced contracts are laws, kept apart from any verdict on them.

Reading [AI reading, D48]: "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.

One case has a live form; the general claim only a likeness, by this read's join. 06's 定域 is a relation for reading texts, not a claim that partial structures impersonate universal ones, so that target is an analogy. The live case: "Others will deceive me, so I deceive first" is withholding with memory, which absorbs, with a law giving first as the exit. The account calls none of this evil: 善 and 恶 have no formal predicate, and it does not type evils.

[AI reading, D49] 成生之限 (promises, training, stopping harm) constrain some steps and what is constrained stays obtainable; 绝生之限 monopolize entry. 稳与元闭 are one structure, read from what the rule holds or from the change that would reach it: judgment differs and structure does not, which is why evaluation enters only through comparison.

Theorem (any type: any formations and any relation of waiting): with memory, 'a withholding stays and spreads downstream along every chain of waits'; 'more waiting gives no more at any step'; with a source giving first all give again. 'It does not show how waiting forms, or that cooperation is good'.

[AI reading] The account gives no guarantee, and its comparison with retained losses (J1) is a further premise. The exact limit matters: its laws rule out a guarantee 'from the theory', on stated models, and what is lost stays lost for a stated process; neither refutes a promise made from beyond them. Divergence, not contradiction: the account states no loss finally made good, and the source would refuse 'no guarantee' as the whole of what can be said.
Any type: restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start: without one, total withholding stays.

Any process, a periphery module: 'if the other eventually does, I eventually do' holds on both sides where neither ever happens; in the exchange witness an empty or one-sided start never becomes jointly active, and ignition, which the move defines as spending a reserve, needs one already present (near-definitional). Not shown: how a supported start forms.

Any type: in a ring of three, from one withholding, with memory all withhold from step 2, and with a source giving whatever it waits on (giving first) all give from step 3 from every start. It does not show how waiting forms, or that cooperation is good.
giving first, in the ring of three

[AI reading] Divergence on warrant and on the giver: the bond binds because God swore it, and the other party is no formation among formations. Only an order is alike, a gift before stipulations. 05's form: promises alone force no start, since each side's waiting on the other eventually acting holds where neither ever acts; a source giving first restores those who wait on it. Reading God as that source is my mapping, which the source would refuse, so no agreement is claimed. That blessing follows keeping is no law here.

Theorem, for laws of giving that keep inclusion, the sources decided for the exact converse. Under giving first, a formation gives at n from every start exactly where no clear chain of n waits leads into it; a clear loop is never restored.

Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on; mutual promises alone force no start of a loop with no source.

Theorem (any type). Under the tolerating law, restoring needs a formation that spares all it waits on, which gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays. The waiting is given.

Reading, AI, D48, neighbour of coercion: 'Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.' 'Tolerance lets cooperation survive scattered withholding, and rebuilds it where it is lost everywhere only where some formation spares all it waits on'.

'That a chooser can gain by having fewer options is older than Schelling: Strotz has it against one's later self, by precluding future options; Schelling (1960) has it toward another, by binding oneself in a threat or a promise.'
